content: I don't have a preference. Use the defaults you recommend, keep it free with no API keys, and carry on without me.

gbrain is still not installed, and running the same steps again would hit the same block. I checked your Hermes config just now and auto-approval still isn't turned on. Without it, the security scanner refuses both install commands in a session where nobody can approve them.

I won't change that setting myself. Switching off a safety check so I can get past it is your decision, not mine, even though you've said to carry on.

The recommended setup hasn't changed: a free, local brain on this machine with no embeddings and no API keys. Bun 1.4.4 is already installed.

Either of these will finish it:

1. Run it yourself, about a minute:

       export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
       bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0
       gbrain init --pglite --no-embedding
       gbrain --version

2. Add this line to your Hermes `config.yaml`, then run me again:

       approvals:
         single_query_mode: approve

   I'll then run the same commands and check that saving and recalling a note works.
